failure.case_transport: directly launched Excel did not expose exact-PID OBJID_NATIVEOM through an owned window
failure.supervisor_surface: ownership ledgers do not bind exactly once to the selected case set
failure.diagnosis: The /x process reached Excel's no-workbook start UI. It exposed XLMAIN and XLDESK but no EXCEL7 native-object-model sheet window. The supervisor then masked the valid case-level transport result with the expected-empty pre-ownership ledger binding check.

repair_disposition: Generate and validate a deterministic macro-free OpenXML bootstrap workbook with closed OPC relationships; launch exact excel.exe with exactly ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList ['/x', bootstrap-path]; reject truncated or foreign-PID window enumeration; attach only through an exact-PID EXCEL7/OBJID_NATIVEOM result; stop relaunches on absence of a durable ownership record; and use the pure post-cleanup result/ledger validator to surface only the exact first-case pre-ownership transport with both ledgers empty and the failed exit envelope.
